cli.build.template.guidance.help: write the section, then remove the <!-- guidance: … --> comment
cli.new.summaryPlaceholder: To write: one sentence that says what the reader finds on this page.
cli.new.tocEnd: ✔ {toc}: “{id}” added at the end of the group “{group}” (section {section})
cli.new.next: → write the page ({file}) and its summary in {toc}, then look at it: {command} dev
cli.new.parentHint: tip: to make it a sub-page of “{parent}”, move its entry after that page with "level": 2 (--parent {parent} does it at creation)
cli.new.invalidId.help: lower-case segments separated by “/”, the first one being the id of the section, for example use/orders/export
cli.new.noToc.help: create the project with {command} init, or check paths.content in doc.config.mjs
cli.new.invalidToc: the table of contents cannot be updated: {file} ({error})
cli.new.invalidToc.help: fix the file ({command} build --draft shows the errors), then try again
cli.new.exists.help: nothing was written: choose another id, or edit the page
cli.new.templateConflict: “{id}” is declared with the template “{declared}”, not “{template}”
cli.new.templateConflict.help: remove --template, or change the template of the page in {file}
cli.new.unknownParent.help: give the id of a page declared in {file}
cli.new.parentIsSubPage.help: give its parent page instead: sub-pages have a single level
cli.new.parentSection: the parent “{parent}” is in the section “{section}”, not in the section of “{id}”
cli.new.parentSection.help: a page id starts with the id of its section
cli.new.unknownSection.help: a page id starts with the id of a section: {known}
cli.new.noGroup: the section “{section}” has no group in {file}
cli.new.noGroup.help: add a group to the section first: { "title": "…", "pages": [] }
cli.new.templateFileMissing: page template not found in the kit: {file}
cli.audit.tablesProgress: Measuring table widths: every page is opened in the browser…
cli.audit.title: Documentation audit — {product}
cli.audit.levelSentence.1: the site builds, and each section has its first page.
cli.audit.levelSentence.2: a user finds every screen, annotated.
cli.audit.levelSentence.3: everything is written, covered, typed and conformant; the strict build passes.
cli.audit.levelSentence.4: a team that does not know the project can take it over.
cli.audit.ind.written: declared pages that have their file
cli.audit.ind.conformant: typed pages that have all their required sections
cli.audit.ind.completeness: share of the template's sections present, on average over the typed pages
cli.audit.ind.annotated: screen and editor pages with a `:::screen` (while no page is typed: every page outside Take over)
cli.audit.ind.coverage: inventoried elements that the documentation cites
cli.audit.ind.proofs: Take over pages with a `file:line` proof
cli.audit.ind.guidance: pages that still hold template guidance or the summary placeholder
cli.audit.ind.upToDateCaptures: captures of the current version, among those that carry a version
cli.audit.ind.blocking: strict build errors, uncovered elements and secrets found
cli.audit.crit.sectionsWritten: each section has at least 1 written page
cli.audit.crit.linksLegend: no broken link, no legend that differs from its zones, even in draft mode
cli.audit.takeover.journey: End-to-end journey, with at least 3 steps
cli.audit.takeover.troubleshooting: Troubleshooting by symptom, with at least 2 areas
cli.audit.done: Level 4 reached: keep every indicator green at each release.
cli.audit.noAction: No action computed: see the criteria above.
cli.audit.untypedTitle: This site declares no page type
cli.audit.untypedNote: `typed` = 0 %, like every site written before page types existed: its measured level stays low even when its content is complete. To type a page, add `"{field}": "<type>"` to its entry in `{file}` (the types and their sections: `standard/templates.md`). The build then checks its required sections, and `{command} build --draft` lists what is missing. The actions below name the pages that already follow a template, judged by their headings.
cli.audit.reason.noAdapter: no coverage adapter could inventory the application (`coverage` in `doc.config.mjs`; `{command} check coverage` tells why)
cli.audit.reason.unavailable: the check is not available in this version of the kit
cli.audit.reason.format: unexpected result of the coverage check
cli.audit.reason.browser: browser not found: `npx playwright install chromium`
cli.audit.reason.noSite: the site could not be built
cli.audit.footer: Formulas and thresholds: `standard/maturity.md` in the kit. The audit is informative: its exit code is always 0.

cli.audit.action.draftBuild.one: Fix the error that prevents any build (`{command} build --draft`)
cli.audit.action.draftBuild.other: Fix the {n} errors that prevent any build (`{command} build --draft`)

cli.audit.action.sectionsWritten.one: Write the first page of the section that has none
cli.audit.action.sectionsWritten.other: Write the first page of the {n} sections that have none

cli.audit.action.glossary: Add terms to the glossary: {n} today, {threshold} expected ({need} more)
cli.audit.action.tours: Add guided tours (`journeys` in `{file}`): {n} today, {threshold} expected ({need} more), one per reader, 5 to 7 pages each

cli.audit.action.written.one: Write the page declared without its file, outside Take over ({need} needed for the target)
cli.audit.action.written.other: Write the pages declared without their file, outside Take over: {n} missing, at least {need} to write

cli.audit.action.annotated.one: Add an annotated screen (`:::screen` and its numbered legend) to the page that has none (target {percent})
cli.audit.action.annotated.other: Add an annotated screen (`:::screen` and its numbered legend) to at least {need} of the {n} pages that have none (target {percent})

cli.audit.action.coverage.one: Document the element that no page cites ({need} needed)
cli.audit.action.coverage.other: Document the elements that no page cites: {n}, at least {need} of them

cli.audit.action.linksLegend.one: Fix the broken link or the legend that differs from its zones
cli.audit.action.linksLegend.other: Fix the {n} broken links and legends that differ from their zones

cli.audit.action.blocking.one: Fix the error of the strict build (`{command} build`)
cli.audit.action.blocking.other: Fix the {n} errors of the strict build (`{command} build`)

cli.audit.action.typedDeclare.one: Declare the type of the page that already follows a template, judged by its headings: add `"{field}": "<type>"` to its entry in `{file}` ({need} typed pages still needed)
cli.audit.action.typedDeclare.other: Declare the type of the {n} pages that already follow a template, judged by their headings: add `"{field}": "<type>"` to their entry in `{file}` ({need} typed pages still needed)

cli.audit.action.typedChoose: Type at least {need} more pages among the {n} that follow no template yet: add or rename their required sections (closest type below), then declare `"{field}"` in `{file}`. The types and their sections: `standard/templates.md`

cli.audit.action.conformant.one: Add or rename the required sections of the typed page that lacks some (`{command} build --draft` lists them)
cli.audit.action.conformant.other: Add or rename the required sections of the {n} typed pages that lack some (`{command} build --draft` lists them)

cli.audit.action.guidance.one: Write, then remove, the template guidance left in {n} page (`<!-- guidance: … -->`, or the summary placeholder of `{command} new`)
cli.audit.action.guidance.other: Write, then remove, the template guidance left in {n} pages (`<!-- guidance: … -->`, or the summary placeholder of `{command} new`)

cli.audit.action.wideTables.one: Narrow the table that scrolls at 1,440 px: fewer columns, shorter cells, or two tables
cli.audit.action.wideTables.other: Narrow the {n} tables that scroll at 1,440 px: fewer columns, shorter cells, or two tables

cli.audit.action.takeover.one: Complete the Take over pages: {n} of the 7 required is missing
cli.audit.action.takeover.other: Complete the Take over pages: {n} of the 7 required are missing

cli.audit.action.proofs.one: Add a `file:line` proof to at least {need} more Take over pages: {n} has none
cli.audit.action.proofs.other: Add a `file:line` proof to at least {need} more Take over pages: {n} have none

cli.audit.action.completeness: Add the recommended sections of the least complete typed pages (target: {percent} on average; {n} listed)

cli.audit.action.tooLong.one: Split into sub-pages the page beyond its word limit ({need} needed; `standard/structure.md`, Sub-pages)
cli.audit.action.tooLong.other: Split into sub-pages at least {need} of the {n} pages beyond their word limit (`standard/structure.md`, Sub-pages)

cli.audit.action.upToDate.one: Capture again the screen taken on a version other than {current} (`{command} capture`)
cli.audit.action.upToDate.other: Capture again the {n} screens taken on a version other than {current} (`{command} capture`)

cli.audit.item.takeover.number: {label}: number the findings (C1, I1, M1, P1, N1…)

cli.audit.summary.later.one: + {n} action for the next levels: see the report
cli.audit.summary.later.other: + {n} actions for the next levels: see the report

cli.audit.action.secrets.other: Remove the {n} secrets found, then capture again if they are in images (`{command} check secrets`)
